description: Des Moines, IA – Today, the Iowa Farm Bureau endorsed Ashley Hinson for United States Senate, citing her strong track record of delivering for Iowa farmers and rural communities. Josh Turek would be a disaster for Iowa agriculture – he supports California’s Prop 12 regulations, sides with fake-meat activists over Iowa farmers and voted to label fake meat as real, and skipped the vote on the Iowa Farm Bill. “I’m honored to have earned the endorsement of the Iowa Farm Bureau for my record of delivering bipartisan results for Iowa agriculture,” said Ashley Hinson. “Too many people in Washington, on both sides of the aisle, think their food comes from the grocery store. I’ll always support Iowa agriculture, even when it means bucking my own party, and keep fighting to lower input costs, implement year-round E-15, expand market access, and push back on burdensome regulations like Prop 12 so that Iowa farmers can continue to feed and fuel the world.” “Our PAC takes great care evaluating candidates based on voting records, past support and grassroots input from every county Farm Bureau in the state,” said Tim Diamond, Iowa Farm Bureau PAC chair and Grundy County farmer. “Our process is grounded in support for Farm […]
